metadata.question: Did the rate of cropland expansion slow in Africa from 2016-2019 compared to 2004-2007?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) or ESA WorldCover for cropland classification - Need two time periods: 2004-2007 and 2016-2019 - Compare annual rates of cropland expansion between these periods - Africa geometry needed 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for annual land cover products - Focus on cropland class changes over time 3. Logic: - Calculate total cropland area at start and end of each period - Compute annual rate of change for each period - Compare rates: if 2016-2019 rate < 2004-2007 rate, answer is A (Yes, slowed) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculations) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Africa geometry const africa = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.inList('wld_rgn', ['Africa'])); const africaGeom = africa.geometry(); // Use MODIS Land Cover Type Yearly Global 500m const modisLC = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .select('LC_Type1'); // Get images for both periods const img2004 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2004-01-01', '2004-12-31')).first(); const img2007 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2007-01-01', '2007-12-31')).first(); const img2016 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31')).first(); const img2019 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31')).first(); // Check if images exist const count2004 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2004-01-01', '2004-12-31')).size().getInfo(); const count2007 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2007-01-01', '2007-12-31')).size().getInfo(); const count2016 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31')).size().getInfo(); const count2019 = modisLC.filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31')).size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found - 2004: ${count2004}, 2007: ${count2007}, 2016: ${count2016}, 2019: ${count2019}`); if (count2004 === 0 || count2007 === 0 || count2016 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or more years'); console.log('C1'); return; } // MODIS LC_Type1: Croplands = 12, Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic = 14 const croplandMask2004 = img2004.eq(12).or(img2004.eq(14)); const croplandMask2007 = img2007.eq(12).or(img2007.eq(14)); const croplandMask2016 = img2016.eq(12).or(img2016.eq(14)); const croplandMask2019 = img2019.eq(12).or(img2019.eq(14)); // Calculate cropland area in km² for each year const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6); // Convert to km² const area2004 = croplandMask2004.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africaGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const area2007 = croplandMask2007.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africaGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const area2016 = croplandMask2016.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africaGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const area2019 = croplandMask2019.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africaGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); console.log(`Cropland area (km²) - 2004: ${Math.round(area2004)}, 2007: ${Math.round(area2007)}`); console.log(`Cropland area (km²) - 2016: ${Math.round(area2016)}, 2019: ${Math.round(area2019)}`); if (area2004 === null || area2007 === null || area2016 === null || area2019 === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (area2004 === 0 || area2007 === 0 || area2016 === 0 || area2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid cropland pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate annual rates of change const period1Years = 3; // 2004 to 2007 const period2Years = 3; // 2016 to 2019 const rate1 = (area2007 - area2004) / period1Years; // km²/year const rate2 = (area2019 - area2016) / period2Years; // km²/year console.log(`Annual expansion rate 2004-2007: ${Math.round(rate1)} km²/year`); console.log(`Annual expansion rate 2016-2019: ${Math.round(rate2)} km²/year`); // Check if expansion rate slowed if (rate2 < rate1) { console.log('Expansion rate slowed in 2016-2019'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Expansion rate did not slow in 2016-2019'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
